_about: Board 0 stores and castles as units: everything drawn for one space, so a building is moved as one piece (tools/boardview/units.py). The sign is not listed: it follows the space record through the nameplate and sign placement lists in stg000. Found with the hide/lift/move tests in tools/live and tools/testpatch; every part was seen moving in the running game.

_parts.matrix: [model, index in its MTRX chunk]: the translation is moved
_parts.cluster: [model, mesh]: the ONE set of vertices connected through triangles whose centre is nearest to `centre` (original coordinates); `vertices` is its size, checked when it is picked
_parts.area: [model, mesh]: every cluster of welded vertices (vertices that share a position count as one) whose centre is within `radius` of `centre`; used for buildings baked into a batch mesh in world coordinates
_parts.role: building, shadow or decor (what the part draws)
_parts.adjust: optional [x, y, z] added to a part's move when the unit leaves home

parts.note: radius 11 leaves the steps' neighbours; 18 also takes the purple mushrooms around it

incomplete._: Spaces whose shadow is mapped but whose building is not, so they cannot move yet.

weapon_store_emblems._: The golden sword-and-shield emblem above each weapon store: a 749-vertex piece with the same raw coordinates for every store (centre (-389, 61)); a per-store transform that is not in the matrix list places it. Found by lifting each piece by a different height. The store bodies (walls, door, steps) are separate pieces and not mapped yet.
